title: Treat unknown compatibility fields explicitly
description: Ensure unknown setup fields never match as wildcards and allow exact operator attestation only when no known contradiction exists.
acceptanceCriteria: Every unknown required field produces a stable required-confirmation or unresolved reason instead of an automatic match
A matching attestation references exact current assumptions and can satisfy only listed unknown sameness confirmations
Any known contradiction remains incompatible regardless of generic or stale attestation
Changing referenced assumptions invalidates the attestation for compatibility

steps.details: Add per-field unknown reason and confirmation requirements to compatibility results, preserving canonical order.
Accept only attestations whose setup/loading/configuration identities and disclosure version match the current request and whose scope covers the unknown field.
Ensure known contradictions cannot be removed or downgraded by any attestation path.
Cover each unknown field, exact attestation, missing scope, changed revision, stale disclosure, known contradiction, and generic confirmation refusal.

technicalNotes: Maximum execution scope is ten minutes; implement unknown and attestation rules as focused evaluator cases.
Attestation confirms an operator assertion only; it does not turn unknown metadata into browser-observed fact.
Known contradictions are never overrideable through this task.
